product.name: IVAR chair
product.note: Parts only: screws and fittings aren’t shown, and sizes are approximate. Each step names the page of your paper manual to follow.

steps.title: Start with 4 rails, a panel and a piece
steps.instruction: Join 4 rails, a panel and a piece (A, B, C, D, E, F), as the animation shows. Page 3 of the IKEA manual shows this step.
checklist: 4 rails, a panel and a piece are joined

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the IVAR chair. Page 3 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
The blue parts: A (rail, about 27 cm), B (panel, about 82 cm), C (rail, about 27 cm), D (rail, about 28 cm), E (rail, about 27 cm), F (piece, about 82 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 82 cm tall.

steps.title: Add a board
steps.instruction: Attach a board (G) to what you have built so far, as the animation shows. Page 4 of the IKEA manual shows this step.

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the IVAR chair. Page 4 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
